How it scores

Each zone line and each port counts as one hop; a boat counts as two, since you wait for it. A port is cast where you stand, so it skips everything between you and its destination — switching ports off shows you the walk instead. Where several routes tie — with ports, they often do — the page picks one and stays with it, so the same choices always give you the same route.

About the map

Expansions can be switched off — a server running classic only has no Kunark or Velious to route through, so those zones leave the map, the pickers and the search entirely. The world map is schematic: continents sit in their rough relative positions and each dot is a zone. The zone cards are not — each is traced from that zone's own Brewall map file, and the pins sit on the real zone-line coordinates. Zones are drawn in the orientation the in-game map uses, so a card should match what you see on screen. A pin marked approx. is one the map file did not label, placed instead by bearing from the world map.

Hops, not minutes

Every zone line costs the same, whatever lies between them. Ak'Anon and the Eastern Wastes are each one hop, though one is a stroll and the other a long run — and a route may enter a zone at one corner and leave by the far one. Zone size, terrain, run speed and the distance between the two zone lines carry no weight here, so the fewest zone lines is not always the quickest on foot.

Privacy

This page loads nothing from anyone: the fonts are embedded, there are no analytics, no cookies, no tracking and no storage. Nothing you select here leaves your browser. The only party that sees a request is whoever hosts the page, whose server logs record visitor IP addresses as all web servers do.

Map credit

Zone geometry is traced from Brewall's EverQuest maps (brewall-20240109) by Brewall Rainsinger, with some zones revised by Goodurden — the map pack most of Norrath has navigated by for twenty years. EverQuest is a trademark of Daybreak Game Company; this page is unaffiliated with either.

Fixing the map

Zones, coordinates, connections and port lists live in ZONES, EDGES, DRUID and WIZARD at the top of the script. Data covers classic Norrath through Kunark and Velious; correct anything your server does differently and reload.
